pattern.description: A fast horizontal whip pan with heavy motion blur carries the viewer from the desert daytime scene into a dusk courtyard; as the blur resolves, a giant semi-transparent white word (cropped, reads 'virtu...', likely 'virtual') snaps on over the footage.
pattern.why_premium: The whip lands exactly on the narration 'day to the night', and the oversized cropped type layered over live action turns the landing frame into a kinetic-type beat without hiding the subject.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to('.sceneA',{xPercent:-60,filter:'blur(24px)',duration:0.15,ease:'power3.in'}).fromTo('.sceneB',{xPercent:60,filter:'blur(24px)'},{xPercent:0,filter:'blur(0px)',duration:0.2,ease:'power3.out'}).set('.bigWord',{autoAlpha:0.7}) — word set on (or 1-2 frame fade) right as blur clears; mix-blend-mode: screen.
build_hint.remotion: Translate scene A/B with interpolate(frame,[0,4,9],[0,-60,..]) in percent using Easing.inOut(Easing.cubic) plus a blur filter peaking mid-whip; big word opacity interpolate(frame,[9,10],[0,0.7]). No spring.

notes: camera.move is pan_right but the content travels left (pan_x negative); labelled slide_left for the footage. The word is cropped at both edges; 'virtu' is what is visible, full word likely 'virtual' (check following frames). Event sits in shot s012 though the scene changes, so a shot boundary may be missed.
